it.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: Percorso che termina a una bandierina con un segno di spunta
it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: Alcune domande veloci sullo spostamento appena fatto.
it.#Compared to what you expected, how long: Rispetto a quanto ti aspettavi, quanto ti è sembrato lungo questo spostamento?
it.#A little shorter than expected: Un po' più breve del previsto
it.#A little longer than expected: Un po' più lungo del previsto
it.#How tiring was this trip?: Quanto è stato faticoso questo spostamento?
it.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Quanto ti sentivi al sicuro dal traffico durante questo spostamento?
it.#How safe did you feel from other people: Quanto ti sentivi al sicuro rispetto ad altre persone (ad es. furti, molestie)?
it.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Un percorso che conosco, ma non quello abituale
it.#Why did you choose this route? (Up to 2: Perché hai scelto questo percorso? (Al massimo 2)
it.#It's the quickest or shortest: È il più veloce o il più breve
it.#It's safer from traffic: È più sicuro rispetto al traffico
it.#There are more people around: Ci sono più persone in giro
it.#It's nicer or greener: È più bello o più verde
it.#To stop somewhere on the way: Per fermarmi da qualche parte lungo la strada
it.#A navigation app suggested it: Me l'ha suggerito un'app di navigazione
it.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: Durante questo spostamento hai evitato di proposito una strada, un attraversamento o un luogo?
it.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: Perché l'hai evitato? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Durante questo spostamento è successo qualcuno di questi episodi? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Un'auto, un furgone, un autobus o una moto ha rischiato di investirmi
it.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Ho rischiato uno scontro con una bici o un monopattino
it.#I tripped or fell: Ho inciampato o ho fatto una caduta
it.#I was harassed or felt threatened: Ho subito molestie o ho percepito una minaccia
it.#How would you rate this trip overall?: Come valuteresti questo spostamento nel complesso?
it.#How did you feel emotionally after this: Che emozioni hai provato dopo questo spostamento? (Al massimo 2)
it.#Anything else you want to tell us about: Vuoi dirci altro su questo spostamento? (Facoltativo)
it.#The pedestrian light was too short: Il semaforo pedonale era troppo breve
it.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: Il mio solito percorso era chiuso o deviato (ad es. lavori)
it.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Un veicolo mi è passato troppo vicino
it.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: Circa due minuti: cinque brevi valutazioni sono obbligatorie, il resto è facoltativo. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a capire com'è andato davvero lo spostamento.

fr.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: Itinéraire se terminant à un drapeau avec une coche
fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: Quelques questions rapides sur le trajet que vous venez de faire.
fr.#Compared to what you expected, how long: Par rapport à ce que vous attendiez, ce trajet vous a-t-il semblé long ?
fr.#A little shorter than expected: Un peu moins longtemps que prévu
fr.#A little longer than expected: Un peu plus long que prévu
fr.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: À quel point vous sentiez-vous en sécurité face à la circulation pendant ce trajet ?
fr.#How safe did you feel from other people: À quel point vous sentiez-vous en sécurité vis-à-vis des autres personnes (par ex. vol, harcèlement) ?
fr.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Un itinéraire que je connais, mais pas mon itinéraire habituel
fr.#Why did you choose this route? (Up to 2: Pourquoi avez-vous choisi cet itinéraire ? (2 au maximum)
fr.#It's the quickest or shortest: C'est le plus rapide ou le plus court
fr.#It's safer from traffic: Il est plus sûr par rapport à la circulation
fr.#There are more people around: Il y a plus de monde
fr.#It's nicer or greener: Il est plus agréable ou plus vert
fr.#It has fewer slopes or stairs: Il y a moins de pentes ou d'escaliers
fr.#Better pavements or cycle lanes: De meilleurs trottoirs ou pistes cyclables
fr.#To stop somewhere on the way: Pour m'arrêter quelque part en chemin
fr.#A navigation app suggested it: Une application de navigation me l'a suggéré
fr.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: Avez-vous délibérément évité une rue, un passage ou un lieu pendant ce trajet ?
fr.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: Pourquoi l'avez-vous évité ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s'appliquent)
fr.#Bad pavement or road surface: Mauvais trottoir ou chaussée en mauvais état
fr.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: L'une de ces situations s'est-elle produite pendant ce trajet ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s'appliquent)
fr.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Une voiture, une camionnette, un bus ou une moto a failli me renverser
fr.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: J'ai failli entrer en collision avec un vélo ou une trottinette électrique
fr.#I tripped or fell: J’ai trébuché ou j’ai fait une chute
fr.#I was harassed or felt threatened: J’ai subi du harcèlement ou j’ai ressenti une menace
fr.#How would you rate this trip overall?: Comment évalueriez-vous ce trajet dans l'ensemble ?
fr.#How did you feel emotionally after this: Quelles émotions avez-vous ressenties après ce trajet ? (2 au maximum)
fr.#Anything else you want to tell us about: Voulez-vous nous dire autre chose sur ce trajet ? (Facultatif)
fr.#The pedestrian light was too short: Le feu piéton était trop court
fr.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: Mon trajet habituel était fermé ou dévié (par ex. travaux)
fr.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Un véhicule est passé trop près de moi
fr.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: Environ deux minutes : cinq courtes évaluations sont obligatoires, le reste est facultatif. Vos réponses nous aident à comprendre comment le trajet s'est vraiment passé.

de.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: Route, die an einer Flagge endet, mit einem Häkchen
de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: Ein paar kurze Fragen zu dem Weg, den Sie gerade zurückgelegt haben.
de.#Compared to what you expected, how long: Wie lang hat sich dieser Weg im Vergleich zu Ihrer Erwartung angefühlt?
de.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Wie sicher vor dem Verkehr haben Sie sich auf diesem Weg gefühlt?
de.#How safe did you feel from other people: Wie sicher haben Sie sich gegenüber anderen Menschen gefühlt (z. B. Diebstahl, Belästigung)?
de.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Eine Route, die ich kenne, aber nicht meine übliche
de.#Why did you choose this route? (Up to 2: Warum haben Sie diese Route gewählt? (Bis zu 2)
de.#It's the quickest or shortest: Sie ist die schnellste oder kürzeste
de.#It's safer from traffic: Sie ist sicherer vor dem Verkehr
de.#It has fewer slopes or stairs: Sie hat weniger Steigungen oder Treppen
de.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: Haben Sie auf diesem Weg bewusst eine Straße, eine Querung oder einen Ort gemieden?
de.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: Warum haben Sie ihn gemieden? (Alle zutreffenden auswählen)
de.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Ist auf diesem Weg etwas davon passiert? (Alle zutreffenden auswählen)
de.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Ich wäre fast von einem Auto, Lieferwagen, Bus oder Motorrad angefahren worden
de.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Beinahe-Zusammenstoß mit einem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter
de.#I was harassed or felt threatened: Ich wurde belästigt oder habe mich bedroht gefühlt
de.#How would you rate this trip overall?: Wie würden Sie diesen Weg insgesamt bewerten?
de.#How did you feel emotionally after this: Wie haben Sie sich nach diesem Weg emotional gefühlt? (Bis zu 2)
de.#Anything else you want to tell us about: Möchten Sie uns noch etwas zu diesem Weg mitteilen? (Optional)
de.#The pedestrian light was too short: Die Fußgängerampel war zu kurz grün
de.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: Mein üblicher Weg war gesperrt oder umgeleitet (z. B. Baustelle)
de.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Ein Fahrzeug ist zu nah an mir vorbeigefahren
de.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: Etwa zwei Minuten: Fünf kurze Bewertungen sind Pflicht, der Rest ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten helfen uns zu verstehen, wie der Weg wirklich verlaufen ist.

tr.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: Bayrakta biten güzergâh ve onay işareti
tr.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: Az önce yaptığınız yolculukla ilgili birkaç kısa soru.
tr.#Compared to what you expected, how long: Beklediğinize kıyasla bu yolculuk size ne kadar uzun geldi?
tr.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Bu yolculukta kendinizi trafiğe karşı ne kadar güvende hissettiniz?
tr.#How safe did you feel from other people: Diğer insanlara karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissettiniz (örn. hırsızlık, taciz)?
tr.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Bildiğim ama her zamanki olmayan bir güzergâh
tr.#It's the quickest or shortest: En hızlı veya en kısa olan bu
tr.#It has fewer slopes or stairs: Daha az eğim veya merdiven var
tr.#Better pavements or cycle lanes: Daha iyi kaldırımlar veya bisiklet yolları
tr.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: Bu yolculukta bilerek bir sokaktan, geçitten veya yerden kaçındınız mı?
tr.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Bu yolculukta bunlardan herhangi biri oldu mu? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Az kalsın bir otomobil, kamyonet, otobüs veya motosiklet bana çarpıyordu
tr.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Bir bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter ile çarpışmaktan kıl payı kurtuldum
tr.#I was harassed or felt threatened: Tacize uğradım veya kendimi tehdit altında hissettim
tr.#How would you rate this trip overall?: Bu yolculuğu genel olarak nasıl değerlendirirsiniz?
tr.#How did you feel emotionally after this: Bu yolculuktan sonra duygusal olarak kendinizi nasıl hissettiniz? (En fazla 2)
tr.#Anything else you want to tell us about: Bu yolculukla ilgili bize söylemek istediğiniz başka bir şey var mı? (İsteğe bağlı)
tr.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: Her zamanki yolum kapalıydı veya yönlendirilmişti (ör. yol çalışması)
tr.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: Yaklaşık iki dakika: beş kısa değerlendirme zorunlu, gerisi isteğe bağlı. Yanıtlarınız yolculuğun gerçekte nasıl geçtiğini anlamamıza yardımcı olur.

fa.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: مسیری که به پرچم می‌رسد با علامت تیک
fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: چند پرسش کوتاه درباره سفری که همین حالا انجام دادید.
fa.#Compared to what you expected, how long: در مقایسه با انتظارتان، این سفر چقدر طولانی به نظر رسید؟
fa.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: در این سفر چقدر خود را در برابر ترافیک در امان احساس کردید؟
fa.#How safe did you feel from other people: چقدر خود را در برابر افراد دیگر (مثلاً سرقت، مزاحمت) در امان احساس کردید؟
fa.#A route I know, but not my usual one: مسیری که می‌شناسم، اما مسیر همیشگی‌ام نیست
fa.#Why did you choose this route? (Up to 2: چرا این مسیر را انتخاب کردید؟ (حداکثر ۲ مورد)
fa.#To stop somewhere on the way: برای توقف در جایی در طول مسیر
fa.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: آیا در این سفر عمداً از خیابان، گذرگاه یا مکانی دوری کردید؟
fa.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: چرا از آن دوری کردید؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: آیا در این سفر یکی از این موارد رخ داد؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: نزدیک بود یک ماشین، ون، اتوبوس یا موتورسیکلت با من برخورد کند
fa.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: نزدیک بود با یک دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی برخورد کنم
fa.#I was harassed or felt threatened: مورد مزاحمت قرار گرفتم یا احساس تهدید کردم
fa.#How would you rate this trip overall?: در مجموع، این سفر را چگونه ارزیابی می‌کنید؟
fa.#How did you feel emotionally after this: بعد از این سفر چه احساس عاطفی داشتید؟ (حداکثر ۲ مورد)
fa.#Anything else you want to tell us about: چیز دیگری درباره این سفر می‌خواهید به ما بگویید؟ (اختیاری)
fa.#The pedestrian light was too short: چراغ عابر پیاده خیلی کوتاه بود
fa.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: مسیر همیشگی‌ام بسته بود یا تغییر کرده بود (مثلاً به‌خاطر کارهای عمرانی)
fa.#A vehicle passed too close to me: یک وسیلهٔ نقلیه خیلی نزدیک از کنارم رد شد
fa.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: حدود دو دقیقه: پنج ارزیابی کوتاه الزامی است و بقیه اختیاری است. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند بفهمیم سفر واقعاً چگونه گذشت.

hu.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Válaszait elmentettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt ránk.
hu.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: Néhány gyors kérdés az imént megtett útról.
hu.#Compared to what you expected, how long: Ahhoz képest, amire számított, mennyire tűnt hosszúnak ez az út?
hu.#How tiring was this trip?: Mennyire volt fárasztó ez az út?
hu.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: Mennyire érezte magát biztonságban a forgalomtól ezen az úton?
hu.#How safe did you feel from other people: Mennyire érezte magát biztonságban más emberektől (pl. lopás, zaklatás)?
hu.#A route I know, but not my usual one: Egy ismert, de nem a szokásos útvonalam
hu.#It's the quickest or shortest: Ez a leggyorsabb vagy a legrövidebb
hu.#It has fewer slopes or stairs: Kevesebb az emelkedő vagy a lépcső
hu.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: Szándékosan elkerült egy utcát, átkelőt vagy helyet ezen az úton?
hu.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: Miért kerülte el? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Történt ezek közül valamelyik ezen az úton? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Majdnem elütött egy autó, kisteherautó, busz vagy motor
hu.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Majdnem összeütköztem egy kerékpárral vagy e-rollerrel
hu.#How would you rate this trip overall?: Összességében hogyan értékelné ezt az utat?
hu.#How did you feel emotionally after this: Hogyan érezte magát érzelmileg az út után? (Legfeljebb 2)
hu.#Anything else you want to tell us about: Szeretne még valamit elmondani erről az útról? (Nem kötelező)
hu.#The pedestrian light was too short: A gyalogos lámpa túl rövid ideig volt zöld
hu.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: A szokásos útvonalam le volt zárva vagy el volt terelve (pl. útépítés)
hu.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Egy jármű túl közel haladt el mellettem
hu.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: Körülbelül két perc: öt rövid értékelés kötelező, a többi nem kötelező. Válaszai segítenek megérteni, hogyan zajlott valójában az út.

ar.#Route ending at a flag with a check mar: مسار ينتهي عند علم مع علامة صح
ar.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: تم حفظ إجاباتك. شكرًا لك على وقتك.
ar.#<p>A few quick questions about the trip: بضعة أسئلة سريعة عن الرحلة التي قمت بها للتو.
ar.#Compared to what you expected, how long: مقارنةً بما توقعته، كم بدت لك هذه الرحلة طويلة؟
ar.#How safe from traffic did you feel on t: إلى أي مدى شعرت بالأمان من حركة المرور في هذه الرحلة؟
ar.#How safe did you feel from other people: إلى أي مدى شعرت بالأمان من الأشخاص الآخرين (مثل السرقة أو التحرش)؟
ar.#A route I know, but not my usual one: مسار أعرفه، لكنه ليس مساري المعتاد
ar.#It's safer from traffic: إنه أكثر أمانًا من حركة المرور
ar.#To stop somewhere on the way: للتوقف في مكان ما في الطريق
ar.#Did you deliberately avoid a street, cr: هل تجنبت عمدًا شارعًا أو معبرًا أو مكانًا في هذه الرحلة؟
ar.#Why did you avoid it? (Select all that: لماذا تجنبته؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: هل حدث أي من هذه الأمور في هذه الرحلة؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: كدت أن تصدمني سيارة أو شاحنة صغيرة أو حافلة أو دراجة نارية
ar.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: كدت أن أصطدم بدراجة أو سكوتر كهربائي
ar.#How would you rate this trip overall?: ما تقييمك لهذه الرحلة بشكل عام؟
ar.#How did you feel emotionally after this: ما المشاعر التي شعرت بها بعد هذه الرحلة؟ (حتى خيارين)
ar.#Anything else you want to tell us about: أي ملاحظات أخرى عن هذه الرحلة؟ (اختياري)
ar.#My usual route was closed or diverted (: كان طريقي المعتاد مغلقًا أو محوّلًا (مثل أشغال الطرق)
ar.#<p>About two minutes: five short rating: حوالي دقيقتين: خمسة تقييمات قصيرة إلزامية، والباقي اختياري. تساعدنا إجاباتك على فهم كيف سارت الرحلة فعلًا.
